learning: Structural checks (headers, abs-path scan, trail exclusion) all passed, but fidelity failed: PowerShell 5.1 Get-Content -Raw decodes UTF-8 as ANSI, corrupting non-ASCII (em-dash U+2014 -> mojibake).
Fix for loop 2: read each file with [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText(path, UTF8) and write with [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(path, text, UTF8Encoding($false)) to preserve bytes and avoid BOM.
Lesson: a 'source dump' must be byte-faithful; verify codepoints, not just line counts.
next_cycle: loop 2 on same trail — regenerate dump with UTF-8-safe IO.
